title: Manufacturing procurement receipt bundle
description: Purchase-order and receiving evidence for governed procurement receipt.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: WorkflowBundle
metadata:
  name: manufacturing-procurement-receipt
  title: Manufacturing procurement receipt bundle
  description: Purchase-order and receiving evidence for governed procurement receipt.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  workflowRef: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-supply-02
  ontology:
    ref: ladder://ontologies/builtin/manufacturing
    mode: sliver
    selection:
      propertyRefs: [supplier.supplier_name, purchase_order.purchase_order_number, purchase_order.total_amount, receiving_record.receiving_report_number, receiving_record.receipt_date]
      relationshipIds: [supplied_by, orders, fulfilled_by]
  forms:
    - { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/manufacturing/receiving_report, role: completion }
  documents:
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/manufacturing/purchase_order, role: supporting }
